<?php
function wider_get_rhs(): int { echo "BADRHS;"; return 9; }
class NullableNameGet {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return $incoming !== "no"; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === (string) $incoming ? "S;" : "BADTYPE;";
        echo "G:", $incoming, ";";
        return 7;
    }
}
class UnionNameGet {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return $incoming !== "no"; }
    public function __get(int|string $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === (string) $incoming ? "S;" : "BADTYPE;";
        echo "G:", $incoming, ";";
        return 7;
    }
}
class MixedNameGet {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return $incoming !== "no"; }
    public function __get(mixed $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === (string) $incoming ? "S;" : "BADTYPE;";
        echo "G:", $incoming, ";";
        return 7;
    }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BADSET;"; }
}
class WiderGetOnly {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __get(int|string $incoming) { echo "BADGET;"; return 7; }
}
$name = "12";
$o = new NullableNameGet;
echo "N;";
echo isset($o->no) ? "BAD;" : "IF;";
echo isset($o->$name) ? "IT;" : "BAD;";
$o = new UnionNameGet;
echo "U;";
echo empty($o->no) ? "EF;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($o->$name) ? "BAD;" : "ET;";
$o = new MixedNameGet;
echo "M;";
echo ($o->no ?? 9) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";
echo ($o->$name ?? 9) === 7 ? "VALUE;" : "BAD;";
echo ($o->yes ??= wider_get_rhs()) === 7 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD;";
$only = new WiderGetOnly;
echo empty($only->yes) ? "SKIP;" : "BAD;";
